title: Gran's Illness
lines: Gran had an illness and sat in bed.
Meg felt sadness when she saw her gran.
Meg made hot soup and took it up.
Gran's room was dark, so Meg lit a lamp.
Gran ate it all and sat up tall.
"Your kindness made me well," said Gran.
Meg's sadness was gone. Now came gladness.

questions.ask: What did Meg make for her gran?
questions.listenFor: Hot soup in a big pot. It is in the third line, so a rereader can find it fast.

questions.ask: Why did Meg light a lamp?
questions.listenFor: Gran's room was dark. Line four says it. Sadness, gladness, kindness, illness - -ness turns a describing word into a thing.

questions.ask: What would you do for someone at home who felt sad? Why?
questions.listenFor: Any kind answer counts. You are listening for the because part, not for a right idea.
